newsitem.title: USA: US Treasury 5-yr notes seen yielding 3.72-3.74 pct.
newsitem.headline: US Treasury 5-yr notes seen yielding 3.72-3.74 pct.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury's auction of $8.0 billion in inflation-indexed (TIPS) 5-year notes on Wednesday should produce a yield around 3.72 to 3.74 percent, dealers said.
Bidding is expected to be limted, dealers said.
Before the bidding deadline of 1300 EDT/1700 GMT, the 5-year notes were trading with a when-issued yield of 3.715 percent.
Results for the auction are expected around 1345 EDT/1745 GMT.
